notes.text: 1 Pro سائر الكواكب, in capite ipso et apud Platonem legitur الكواكب الثابتة — 2 Cod. الكائن —

observations: N01: the numbers of notes 1 and 2 are printed without the parenthesis (3) has it); the line ends with a dash.
L13: الاتّصالات has no hamza: the alif of the lām-alif ends in the club head of the type (no separate mark), the mark above is the shadda over the tā'; ألقت has its hamza.
L02: وينجلى ends with a dotless yā', as printed (700 dpi, room under the bowl).
L01: يبتدئ ends with a dotless yā' carrying the hamza (1600 dpi), no sukun.
L10, L19, N01: the long joins of والعــرض, للرصــد and الــكائن are not transcribed.
